thread:
maya: FYI vuln sweep found svc-pay-xfer@redwood-prod with project Owner on payments-prod AND KMS encrypter role. Need owner + justification and any PR/ticket. @rahul do you recognize this SA? :eyes:

jamal: Ack. Which binding exactly? paste the snippet or link to IAM snapshot.

maya: IAM snapshot shows: `roles/owner` -> `serviceAccount:svc-pay-xfer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on `projects/payments-prod`. Audit event 2026-03-18T03:12Z. Raw event: https://logs.internal/reports/499888-evidence (internal)

oli: Owner on a service account is atypical. If we can't find a documented owner within 12h, let's plan a temp downgrade to roles/editor and open a remediation ticket.

sasha: audits-bot assembled an evidence bundle and uploaded to s3: https://s3.internal/audit-views/payments-svc-pay-xfer-499888.csv (includes IAM snapshot, KMS grants, last-30d token usage).

audits-bot: auto-note: evidence bundle generated for thread 4998887776. Contains IAM bindings, KMS grant dump, token use histogram.

jamal: KMS follow-up: does this SA have cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on any customer keys? If so we need key rotation plan + decrypt op proof.

maya: It has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on `projects/payments-prod/locations/global/keyRings/customer-keys/ck-main`. Decrypt ops: 12 calls in last 7 days by this SA (see bundle).

rahul: I saw a long-ago infra PR (PR#637) that touched payments IAM; looks unrelated but might have been where owner was added by automation. PR link: https://git.internal/infra/PR-637 (note: author was a retired bot account). No documented justification in PR text.

oli: That's weak evidence. Plan: 1) owners to respond within 12h. 2) if no owner, @oncall apply emergency temp downgrade to roles/editor (no Owner perms) within 12-18h. 3) Jamal to draft KMS rotation + rewrap plan within 48h. 4) run least-privilege sweep for payments-prod SAs next week.

oncall: oncall here  acknowledged. I'll create INC-2026-4998 and coordinate emergency ACLs and paging.

jamal: Commands used to capture state:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy payments-prod --format=json > payments-iam-499888.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner")' payments-iam-499888.json
# list KMS grants
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ck-main --location=global --keyring=customer-keys --project=payments-prod
```

sasha: Evidence hygiene ask: attach any PR/ticket/owner email. If none, mark as undocumented change and create forensics card. Also add a snapshot of last-login/token-use for the SA.

maya: No owner email found. Marked undocumented and filed forensics card. Putting assignments below.

- Jamal: lead KMS rotation plan + schedule (48h).
- Oli: validate dependent jobs, cron schedules, and runbooks (24h).
- Sasha: finalize audit bundle and upload to INC-2026-4998 (12h).
- Rahul: dig PR#637 author and any automation logs (12h).
- Oncall: create INC ticket and apply emergency ACL if no owner confirmed (12-18h).

maya: Also note: include a postmortem template if we rotate keys and it impacts downstream services. Set meeting if rotation affects SLAs.

oncall: Confirmed. Creating INC-2026-4998 now and paging infra owners.

jamal: I'll post the rotation doc link here in ~3h and include an impact matrix.

maya: Thanks team. This thread is canonical remediation coordination for this entitlement. :thumbsup:
